findings.description: Historical PR #124 closeout receipt contained an evaluation timestamp in the future.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict UTC time validation and invalidate future-dated receipts.

findings.description: PR #124 reported migration complete while donor remains active with open issues.
findings.remediation: Reconcile live donor issue states programmatically without premature closure.

findings.description: CLI legislation commands returned fixed static constants.
findings.remediation: Execute real domain operations against actual manifests and checkpoints.

findings.description: Normaliser used regex stripping and assigned universal ACT/IN_FORCE defaults.
findings.remediation: Implement ElementTree XML/HTML parsing extracting true structural and temporal metadata.

findings.description: Treated 33,693 candidate IDs as migrated records with unsupported 100% claim.
findings.remediation: Distinguish candidate IDs, attempted works, retrieved expressions, and published rows.

findings.description: Parity receipts were assertion-only without executable run IDs or checksum bindings.
findings.remediation: Generate differential parity receipts with real manifest hashes and mismatch lists.
